question: Can you suggest a hotel for my upcoming trip to Miami?
gold: The user would prefer suggestions of hotels in Miami that offer great views, possibly of the ocean or the city skyline, and have unique features such as a rooftop pool or a hot tub on the balcony. They may not prefer suggestions of basic or budget hotels without these features.
our_response:
No — the profile contains no Miami hotel records; it only covers Seattle hotels for your planned Seattle trip (e.g., The Edgewater Hotel, Four Seasons Hotel Seattle, The Alexis Hotel).

Based on your recorded preferences, in Miami you'd want to look for: a room with a private balcony hot tub and great city/water views, a fireplace, a romantic package for two (e.g., breakfast for two with champagne and strawberries, couples' massage credit, concierge service), and a hotel that can accommodate your dietary restrictions with advance notice.

Justification: the profile shows you want city views, a balcony hot tub, a fireplace, package perks, and dietary accommodation (@2023-05-27), but all recorded hotel facts are for Seattle, not Miami.

Four Seasons Hotel Seattle: 5-star downtown hotel with floor-to-ceiling windows and views of the city, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains
The Alexis Hotel: boutique downtown hotel with rooms overlooking the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains; some with Space Needle views
Hyatt at Olive 8: eco-friendly downtown hotel with rooms offering city skyline, Puget Sound, and Olympic Mountain views
Pan Pacific Seattle: hotel in the Belltown neighborhood with rooms featuring Space Needle, Puget Sound, and Olympic Mountain views
W Seattle: modern downtown hotel with rooms featuring city skyline, Puget Sound, and Olympic Mountain views
The Sheraton Seattle Hotel: rooms with city skyline, Puget Sound, and Olympic Mountain views, a few blocks from Pike Place Market
Recommended Seattle rooftop bars: The Roof at The Edgewater Hotel, The Nest at The Hotel Theodore, The Roof Garden at The Sheraton Seattle Hotel, The View Lounge at The Pan Pacific Seattle
Hyatt at Olive 8 has a rooftop pool and hot tub with views of the city skyline and Puget Sound
W Seattle has a rooftop pool called WET, a popular spot for views of the city
The Sheraton Seattle Hotel has a rooftop pool and hot tub with views of the city and Puget Sound
The Edgewater Hotel: some luxury rooms and suites have private balconies with hot tubs overlooking Puget Sound and the Olympic Mountains
Four Seasons Hotel Seattle: some rooms and suites have private balconies with hot tubs and views of the city and Puget Sound
The Alexis Hotel has a rooftop fitness center and lounge with city views
Pan Pacific Seattle has a rooftop garden with views of the city and Puget Sound (no pool or hot tub)
The Edgewater Hotel's Waterfront Suites and Premium Waterfront Suites have private balconies with hot tubs and views of Puget Sound, the Olympic Mountains, and the Seattle skyline
The Edgewater Hotel's Space Needle Suites and Premium Space Needle Suites have private balconies with hot tubs and views of the Space Needle, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains
The Edgewater Hotel room service breakfast is delivered to rooms from 6:00-11:00 AM Mon-Fri and 7:00-11:00 AM on weekends
The Edgewater Hotel accommodates gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, and dairy-free diets, plus kosher or halal with advance notice

Romance Package: room with hot tub on the balcony (Puget Sound and Olympic Mountain views), complimentary room service breakfast for two with champagne and strawberries, $100 couples' massage credit, romantic turndown with chocolates and rose petals
Breakfast and Relaxation Package: room with hot tub on the balcony, complimentary room service breakfast for two, $50 spa or bar credit, and 2:00 PM late checkout

Luxury Getaway Package: room with hot tub on the balcony, complimentary room service breakfast for two with champagne and strawberries, $200 credit for a private dinner with wine pairing, personalized concierge service

Space Needle Romance Package: room with hot tub on the balcony facing the Space Needle, complimentary room service breakfast for two with champagne and strawberries, $100 couples' massage credit, romantic turndown, personalized concierge service

Space Needle Luxury Getaway Package: room with hot tub on the balcony facing the Space Needle, complimentary breakfast for two, $200 private dinner credit, concierge service, and 2:00 PM late checkout

Space Needle Celebration Package: room with hot tub on the balcony facing the Space Needle, complimentary breakfast for two, $50 spa or bar credit, concierge service, and a celebration amenity such as cake or wine
The Edgewater Hotel offers seasonal promotions such as a 'Summer Lovin'' package and a 'Winter Wonderland' package, some including hot tub rooms and complimentary breakfast
The Edgewater Hotel offers Fireplace Rooms with a cozy gas fireplace, which can be combined with the Space Needle Romance Package, subject to availability
Advice: book Space Needle-view hot tub suites well in advance, be flexible with dates, and contact the hotel's reservations team directly to guarantee the package

Advice: when booking, request a room with a view as not all rooms share the same vistas; search 'rooms with a view' or 'waterfront rooms' on hotel websites or booking sites like Expedia or Booking.com
Rooftop pools and hot tubs may have seasonal closures or restrictions, so check with the hotel directly before booking
Suggested luxury apartments or vacation rentals in Seattle as alternatives for balcony hot tubs with city views, noting they may not offer hotel-level service

The Edgewater Hotel room service breakfast menu includes continental items (pastries, yogurt, fruit), eggs, omelets, breakfast sandwiches, pancakes, waffles, French toast, oatmeal, smoothies, avocado toast, breakfast burritos, and quiche
To order room service at The Edgewater Hotel, dial the room service extension from the room phone or place the order through the hotel's mobile app
Tips: specify dietary restrictions or preferences when placing the order, ask the room service team about specific requests, and consider ordering a la carte to customize the breakfast
The Edgewater Hotel offers a champagne and strawberry breakfast package for special occasions via room service
Advice: weekdays may offer better availability than weekends for Space Needle-view suites, and travelers should consider a package that guarantees a Space Needle view room
When booking, ask the hotel about additional amenities or upgrades such as a private dinner at the hotel's restaurant or a personalized welcome amenity
Advice: always read the fine print and check package details to ensure the package includes everything desired
